subject: Odd behavior of facet_wrap vs. facet_grid

messages.author: 91d858618ca72b92
messages.subject: Odd behavior of facet_wrap vs. facet_grid
parts:
After using recast and melt to transform my dataframe to the form I
want, faceting on result_variable works with facet_wrap, but fails with
facet_grid. Any advice on what I am doing wrong? See the example below.

> tmp <- cbind(tmp, x3=rnorm(nrow(tmp)))
>
> tmp.which <- subset(tmp, individual=="a" & type==1 & trt==1, c("x1",
"x2"))
>
> tmp2 <- recast(tmp, individual+trt~result_variable+type, id.var=1:3,
measure.var=6, fun.aggregate=function(x)
c(x1.max.x3=tmp.which$x1[which.max(x)],
x2.max.x3=tmp.which$x2[which.max(x)], x3.max=max(x)))
>
> tmp3 <- melt(tmp2)
>
> pdf()
> qplot(value, data=tmp3, geom="density", alpha=I(0.2), fill=trt) +
facet_wrap(~result_variable, scales="free")
> qplot(value, data=tmp3, geom="density", alpha=I(0.2), fill=trt) +
facet_grid(.~result_variable, scales="free")
Error in `[.data.frame`(data, , vars, drop = FALSE) :
undefined columns selected
> qplot(value, data=tmp3, geom="density", alpha=I(0.2), fill=trt) +
facet_grid(type~result_variable, scales="free")
Error in `[.data.frame`(data, , vars, drop = FALSE) :
undefined columns selected
> dev.off()
pdf
2

Mark Lyman, Statistician
Engineering Systems & Integration, ATK

messages.subject: RE: Odd behavior of facet_wrap vs. facet_grid
parts:
I meant that to be a reproducible example, but I forgot the first line, sorry about that. Here is the example again with the first line.


tmp <- expand.grid(individual=letters, type=factor(1:2), trt=factor(1:2), x1=1:10, x2=1:10)

tmp <- cbind(tmp, x3=rnorm(nrow(tmp)))

tmp.which <- subset(tmp, individual=="a" & type==1 & trt==1, c("x1", "x2"))

tmp2 <- recast(tmp, individual+trt~result_variable+type, id.var=1:3, measure.var=6, fun.aggregate=function(x) c(x1.max.x3=tmp.which$x1[which.max(x)], x2.max.x3=tmp.which$x2[which.max(x)], x3.max=max(x)))

tmp3 <- melt(tmp2)

pdf()
qplot(value, data=tmp3, geom="density", alpha=I(0.2), fill=trt) + facet_wrap(~result_variable, scales="free")
qplot(value, data=tmp3, geom="density", alpha=I(0.2), fill=trt) + facet_grid(.~result_variable, scales="free")
qplot(value, data=tmp3, geom="density", alpha=I(0.2), fill=trt) + facet_grid(type~result_variable, scales="free")

Hi Mark,

Hmmm. Seems to be a weird bug - facet_grid doesn't like
result_variable as facet name (because it uses reshape internally and
is obviously causing a problem). Just call it something else.

Hadley
